messages:
maria: Heads-up 10-min decision: we need to lock a webinar topic for June. Two strong angles: a) "Fallbacks, Rollouts & Reliability" b) "Practical cost wins with batching/caching". Preference for a tech-forward audience. Thoughts?
alex: leaning a) Fallbacks + Rollouts. Good hook: "keep apps online when models fail". We can show routing policies + fallback chain.
ben: a) from ops side yes. I'll bring live incident examples (anonymized). Need a short storyboard for that section.
priya: +1 to a). I can demo canary + automated fallback rules in 8-10 minutes. Will also show how model variants are used for graceful degradation.
sam: Creative can produce a short animated explainer for the fallback chain. Need speaker bios and one key visual by 5/20.
lee: Ops note: I have studio time Thurs 6/3 or Wed 6/9. Which date suits? Also can record speaker intros in advance. calendar-bot: Tentative slot added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1732104567
maria: Proposed format: 40m main + 20m live Q&A. Run-of-show sketch: 
```
00:00-00:05 - Welcome + agenda + poll (maria)
00:05-00:20 - Fallback patterns + routing (Priya)
00:20-00:30 - Ops case study: incident -> rollout -> mitigation (Ben)
00:30-00:40 - Demo: automated fallback chain (Alex + Priya)
00:40-01:00 - Open Q&A + live poll results + CTAs (all)
```
Keep the demo to 8-10 mins to avoid flub.
alex: We'll put a fallback decision matrix slide and a short checklist for product teams. Jordan? (tagged) can you share the customer quote?
ben: I'll sanitize logs and prepare a timeline screenshot. Need access to the incident bucket by 5/18. @infra please grant read.
priya: For the demo, I need two model variants (perf vs quality) and a canned prompt set. Alex can you stub the prompts?
alex: Sure. I'll draft a 6-step demo script and post in the doc by Fri.
sam: Slide deadlines: rough deck by 5/24, final deck + assets by 5/29. Motion graphics short by 5/30.
maria: Marketing asks: 60-90 word landing blurb + 3 bullets of attendee takeaways; speaker headshots; and social copy. Please drop into shared doc.
lee: Locking recording date -> booked Wed 6/9 11:00 PT (final). calendar-bot: Event updated -> Wed 2026-06-09 11:00 PT
calendar-bot: Added asset reminders and recording checklist to event.
ben: Quick ops checklist to include in slide: health checks, circuit-breakers, KV cache monitoring, rollout windows. I'll convert to 3 bullets.
alex: Also propose a 1-slide "what to measure": failover latency, error rates, model divergence.
priya: Rehearsal plan: tech dry run 6/4 9:00 PT (15m), full run-through 6/8 11:00 PT. Can everyone make both?
maria: Please RSVP in the doc and mark availability.
alex: I'll bring latency graphs and a small live demo harness (local). Priya be ready to trigger fallback.
sam: I'll prepare brand-safe variants of the slides and a 30-second promo clip for socials.
lee: I'll set the registration CTA to include a checkbox for "interest in dedicated/private deployment" so we can route leads. Sam, is the marketing form integrated with CRM?
sam: Yes, we'll tag those registrants and send to Sales queue A. Also add a webinar survey for evaluation feedback.
maria: Final asks before we close: everyone post their 60-90 word abstract + 3 takeaways by Tue 5/19 COB. If not posted, you'll be auto-assigned to "lighting round". :grin:
alex: Posted a draft demo script in the doc, feedback welcome.
ben: Incident timeline ready for review, redacted. Dropping into thread doc.
priya: Draft abstract + takeaways uploaded.
sam: I'll schedule brand review 5/26.
lee: Registration page published -> https://events.example.com/webinars/fallbacks-rollouts. calendar-bot: Registration page linked on event.
maria: Great work team 1 locking topic: "Fallbacks, Rollouts & Reliability for LLM-powered apps". Closing thread and moving notes into the webinar doc. Thanks!
